repos_data.description: Oracle3: open-source trading engine and MCP server for prediction markets. Finds fee-adjusted no-arbitrage violations across related event contracts and trades them live on Kalshi, Polymarket and Solana, or on paper, under pre-trade risk limits. 13 MCP tools, JSON CLI, agent skills, 600+ tests.

Systematic options trading intelligence for small accounts. Create desks in your portfolio, allocate capital and risk appetite at Desk Level. Every trade generated by system is specific for the desk keeping in mind capital allocation, risk limits, position sizing
A framework-agnostic risk-management toolkit for systematic traders: position sizing, drawdown control, stops, correlation limits, and a pre-trade validator.
